name: Astra Embedded S
summary: Astra Embedded S is a compact structured-light RGB-D camera for close-range embedded perception. It combines an Orbbec depth ASIC, USB-C power and data and high-frame-rate depth sensing. The exact model is supported by Orbbec OpenNI SDK and its ROS wrappers. Marketing ended in September 2025.

EOL No.: EOL_20250220005
EOL Announcement for Astra Embedded S
Dear customers:
In order to better assist you in addressing market changes and the challenges of technological
innovation, Orbbec Optical has provided the key lifecycle milestone points for the Astra
Embedded S. We hope this information will serve as a reference for your future product planning
and development.
Orbbec Inc.
February 20, 2025
Milestone Date Remark
EOL announcement 2025-02-20 EOL publicity date
EOM 2025-09-30
End of Marketing. The EOM date is the date when
the product stops accepting orders, including
orders for new sites and capacity expansion.
After that date, the product will no longer be sold.
EOS 2027-09-30
End of Service & Support. It refers to the last date
of the service. After the EOS date, Orbbec does
not provide any service for the product .
Including software and hardware problem
support and update.
Replacement product
End of Life product Replacement product
Astra Embedded S
Currently, there is no fully compatible alternative
product available. Customers with related needs
may contact the Orbbec’s sales, product,
and FAE teams for evaluation and
Recommendations on suitable replacement
products.
